{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect the American worker from unfair trade practices by the Chinese government, including currency manipulation and benefiting from a misaligned exchange rate with the dollar, illegal subsidies, and theft of intellectual property.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will rally friends and allies across the world to push back against China or any other country's attempts to undermine international norms.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe the China challenge is not primarily a military one, but they will deter and respond to aggression.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will underscore a global commitment to freedom of navigation and resist the Chinese military's intimidation in the South China Sea.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to the Taiwan Relations Act and will continue to support a peaceful resolution of cross-strait issues consistent with the wishes and best interests of the people of Taiwan.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will stand for the democratic rights of Hong Kong's citizens, rather than stand with President Xi Jinping as he cracks down on Hong Kong's autonomy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fully enforce the Hong Kong Human Rights and Democracy Act, including by sanctioning officials, financial institutions, companies, and individuals responsible for undercutting Hong Kong's autonomy.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will bring the world together to condemn the internment of more than one million Uyghurs and other ethnic minorities in concentration camps in China, using the tools provided by the Uyghur Human Rights Policy Act.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
